parent_goal: Compute historically source-differentiated Western, Hellenistic, Jyotish and other astrology rules; freeze interpretation and timing decisions before any untouched human response/outcome; assess combined forward-blind predictions against independent controls.

experimental_pre_freeze_defaults_not_lil.window_policy: age years continuous, [max(18, contact_age-0.5),min(65, contact_age+0.5)); year length from existing modern engine, NOT historically established temporal conversion
experimental_pre_freeze_defaults_not_lil.applies_only_to: post-birth diagnostic matching of model contacts; no empirical outcomes scored; no participant records ingested
experimental_pre_freeze_defaults_not_lil.note: No timing key or source author geometry has been selected for a final study. These settings are illustrative pre-freeze decisions, not a human model lock.

source_to_construct_rules.source_anchor_exact: gives every one Preferment according to capacity
source_to_construct_rules.source_claim_paraphrase: MC directed to the body of Jupiter brings role-dependent preferment, office or professional advancement (and other benefits).
source_to_construct_rules.modern_bounded_event: Documented elevation to a new official, paid, elected, organizational or professional leadership role with changed title or duties within the contact year.
source_to_construct_rules.ascertainment: Independent appointment, employment, election or professional record dated before any scorer sees the answer. If event type unavailable, report no ascertainment rather than treating it as no event.
exclude: mere increase in revenue without a role change
qualifications: Lilly's preferential outcomes differ with pre-existing occupation/social rank; record eligibility before revealing chart.
Office and trading are source alternatives; this deliberately narrow operational hypothesis is not a literal exhaustive translation.

source_to_construct_rules.source_anchor_exact: it subverts the Natives honour, his commands
source_to_construct_rules.source_claim_paraphrase: MC directed to Saturn's body threatens existing office, favor, honor or command, with contextual elaborations.
source_to_construct_rules.modern_bounded_event: Documented involuntary demotion, dismissal/removal from office, or withdrawal of formal professional or organizational responsibility during the contact year.
source_to_construct_rules.ascertainment: Independent termination, removal, disciplinary or organizational record; retain eligible active office/employment status before seeing contact years.
qualifications: The negative is conditional on having an office, trust or standing to lose.
Do not equate this bodily contact with MC to Saturn's square/opposition separately discussed on page 669.

source_to_construct_rules.source_anchor_exact: enriched in Fortune by the Gifts or Patronage
source_to_construct_rules.source_claim_paraphrase: Ascendant directed to Jupiter's body includes gifts or patronage, better fortune and multiple alternative effects dependent on radix context.
source_to_construct_rules.modern_bounded_event: Documented new material grant, scholarship, substantial gifted property or externally sponsored patronage from a non-household/non-kin person or institution during the contact year.
source_to_construct_rules.ascertainment: Dated grant, gift, property transfer or sponsorship record. Exact qualifying economic significance threshold must be set before any study and adjusted by exposure opportunity, not selected after outcomes.
qualifications: Derived narrow predicate from one of several historical alternatives, not Lilly's claim of a necessary grant.
No numerical value threshold chosen yet: not trial-frozen.

source_to_construct_rules.source_anchor_exact: involved in many Controversies and Law-suits
source_to_construct_rules.source_claim_paraphrase: Ascendant directed to Mars's body includes anger, serious controversy and lawsuits among many conditional adverse effects.
source_to_construct_rules.modern_bounded_event: At least one new documented court case, formal dispute claim or formally submitted complaint in which the participant is a named party during the contact year.
source_to_construct_rules.ascertainment: Independent timestamped filing or official/third-party complaint record, with confidential contents redacted and never committed.
exclude: private verbal disagreement without formal complaint
qualifications: One observable modern discriminator, not an assertion every Mars contact must produce litigation.
No unsafe medical, criminal, violent, or death predictions will be issued to participants.

nonindependence.observed_previous_engine: Earlier 288/288 exact geometric duplicates for specific relabeled ray constructions are one evidence family, not two.
nonindependence.current: Same source-author passages, same participant history, overlapping outcome domains and equal arcs from different geometric methods must not be counted as independent confirmations.
nonindependence.deduplication: Collapse equal ages for same source rule and time key across methods to one candidate exposure containing method identifiers; retain distinct non-equal ages as alternative unselected model choices.

next_required_stages: Authenticate author-specific direction sense and preselect geometry/time-key methods without outcome knowledge, or clearly register modern diagnostic arms as alternatives.
Complete quantitative qualification and opportunity/exposure definitions, including the external-patronage materiality threshold.

Freeze model, charts, participant source quality, exact date windows, questionnaire/outcome definitions, exclusions, competitor/control arms, dependence graph and null tests before prospective outcomes.
Run genuinely untouched human evaluation, report misses, ties, ascertainment gaps, negative controls, and all predeclared arms; do not reuse development cases as validation.
blindness_disclosure: Conversation assistant may have prior user-specific event memories; candidate design is NOT an independent blinded trial even though no event records were consulted in this run. Only previously untouched human participant data can validate.
